# Casper node, sidecar and command-line client

> Operator and integrator references for the Casper node software: casper-client at v5.0.1 (the release CasperAI's commands are pinned to), the casper-sidecar JSON-RPC, SSE and REST server, node and execution-engine changelogs, the binary port protocol, and the Casper 2.0.0 upgrade notes.

Each link fetches the page's raw markdown; the URL after the colon is where it is published.
